title: Unctuous Shaggy Venezuelan Beef Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew featuring feather blade beef and score-fat, perfect for special occasions. This dish is a show-off Venezuelan recipe with a unique fermentation process.
instructions: Heat the score-fat in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef chunks and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, beef broth, red wine, and cumin, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the stew from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the stew overnight to allow the flavors to meld and the meat to become tender.
Reheat the stew over low heat, serving hot.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
